verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an in-product AI that answers plain-language questions across your data, and describes getting expert-level conversational answers about users and product without SQL. That covers the 'insights' half of the story. The 'suggestions' half is not documented, and the evidence is thin marketing copy. The MCP integration delivers answers in external tools, not inside the product, so it isn't credited here. Missing for 10: documented proactive AI suggestions or recommendations, in-depth docs on how in-product AI insights work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Ask questions in plain language — Amplitude AI surfaces answers across all your data.
Start a conversation about your users or product and get expert-level answers in seconds that you can share with your whole org.
